title: ElytraPity
description: Let players claim an elytra if they've traveled too long without finding one.
body:
Tired of spending hours exploring only to never find an elytra? ElytraPity tracks how far each player has traveled and guarantees an elytra once they’ve gone a set distance without finding one. This ensures everyone eventually gets their wings, while still keeping exploration meaningful. Configurable distance thresholds let you balance rarity and accessibility, making ElytraPity perfect for survival servers that want a fair, rewarding experience.

- Configurable messages
- Configurable distance
- Prevents command usage if elytra found
- Only counts distance traveled in the end

Permission: elytrapity.use


<details>
<summary>How to reset a player</summary>
  
  1. Open the player data folder in the plugin folder
  
  2. Find the user's UUID

  3. Delete the corresponding file or change the value

  4. Have the player relog
</details>
